decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ This purpose built end-of-terrace single-family dwellinghouse is considered to be of an insufficient size in accordance with the Council's residential conversion guidelines for sub-division, and the proposals would therefore be detrimental to the residential amenity of future occupiers, and would result in the loss of a single-family dwellinghouse, out of keeping with the character of the area, contrary to adopted UDP Policy H.1.5 (Revised Deposit January 2001 Policy H.3.4).

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposed double garage, by reason of its size and position forward of the main building line of Osborne Road, would be detrimental to the residential amenity of neighbouring properties resulting in enclosure and loss of outlook and would represent an incongruous and obtrusive feature, out of keeping with the character and appearance of the streetscene, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4.

Condition : 3 - 3/ The proposed double garage, due to its size and position, would fail to achieve the necessary pedestrian visibility splays and would require an excessively wide vehicular crossover of 5m width, and would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5 and UDP Revised Deposit January 2001 policy T.1.4.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension,single storey rear extension, detched single storey double garage to rear and conversion of property into 2 self contained flats (1x3 bed and 1x2 bed)
